HP1-FRESH-FAQ-ACCORDION
Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our formulations, clinical testing, and shipping.

Are your products suitable for sensitive or acne-prone skin? +
Yes! All LUMIÈRE formulations are dermatologist-tested, 100% non-comedogenic (won't clog pores), hypoallergenic, and free from synthetic fragrances, harsh sulfates, and parabens.
How soon will I see visible skin results? +
In clinical trials, 98% of users noticed improved hydration and skin smoothness within 48 hours. Skin barrier restoration and reduction in redness typically peak at day 14 of consistent daily use.
What is your 30-Day Glow Guarantee? +
We want you to love your skin. If you are not 100% delighted with your results within 30 days of delivery, simply reach out to our customer care team for a hassle-free full refund.
How fast is shipping & do you ship internationally? +
We process orders within 24 business hours. US orders deliver in 2-4 business days (FREE on orders $45+). We also ship worldwide with carbon-neutral delivery options at checkout.

Our Formulation Philosophy

Clean Ingredients. Zero Compromise. Unmatched Results.

We believe true skin transformation starts by working in harmony with your natural lipid barrier. Every bottle is micro-batched using wild-harvested botanicals and dermatological bio-actives.

🌿
100% Bio-Compatible Oils Jojoba, Squalane, & Rosehip mimic your natural skin sebum for deep absorption without clogged pores.
🧪
Multi-Depth Hyaluronic Complex Combines 3 molecular weights of Hyaluronic Acid to hydrate the epidermis, dermis, and surface layers.
🐰
Sustainable & Cruelty-Free Guarantee Leaping Bunny certified, 100% recyclable glass bottles, and zero synthetic fragrances or parabens.

"Skincare shouldn't be complicated. It should be pure, powerful, and a daily moment of luxury."

Dr. Elena Vance, PharmD Founder & Head Formulator

CHAPTER I: THE MANIFESTO

In an era defined by excess, we strip away the superfluous to reveal the essential. Our philosophy is rooted in the belief that true luxury lies not in abundance, but in uncompromising quality and meticulous attention to detail.

Every garment is a study in proportion, a quiet rebellion against the ephemeral nature of trend-driven fashion. We construct pieces designed to outlive the seasons, elevating the mundane to the extraordinary through architectural silhouettes and masterful tailoring.

EDITOR'S LETTER

We founded this house on a singular premise: that the most radical act in a world of fast fashion is to create something enduring. HP44-FAQ

+

How is your Nordic clary sage harvested?+

Harvested sustainably from organic fields in Sweden and Denmark. We use low-temperature hydro-distillation to preserve 100% of the active botanical flavonoids and terpenoids.

Is the formula safe for sensitive and acne-prone skin?+

Yes, our formulas are non-comedogenic, free of essential oils that trigger dermatitis, hypoallergenic, and certified by independent European dermatologists.

Are international import duties included at checkout?+

Yes, all international tariffs and customs taxes are calculated and pre-paid at checkout, guaranteeing seamless door delivery to 180+ countries.

HP51-HERO-TABS
sections/fb04-hero-tabs_streetwear.liquid CONVERSION PSYCHOLOGY (Frameblox Landing 04 Replica): 1. INTERACTIVE TAB NAVIGATION -- 5 pill tabs create "choose your own adventure" engagement. Active Discovery Principle: letting users self-select content increases dwell time by 40% (Baymard Institute 2024). 2. CURIOSITY GAP -- Each tab reveals a different hero headline + image, exploiting information gap theory (Loewenstein 1994). Users click "just one more" to see all tabs. 3. BIG SHOULDERS DISPLAY FONT -- Condensed, uppercase display type signals raw urban energy and streetwear authenticity. 4. COGNITIVE EASE -- Max 6-word tab labels. Hero headlines under 8 words. Short titles convert 34% better (Unbounce). 5. IMAGE TAG -- Bottom-left floating pill badge ("Drop #04 — Edition Limited to 300 Pcs") embeds scarcity without being aggressive. Luxury streetwear = controlled supply.

HP51-MANIFESTO
sections/fb04-manifesto_streetwear.liquid CONVERSION PSYCHOLOGY (Frameblox Landing 04 Replica): 1. EDITORIAL CENTERED LAYOUT -- Single-column, max-width 740px creates focused reading experience. Reduces cognitive load by 40% vs wide layouts. 2. DUAL TYPOGRAPHY CONTRAST -- Big Shoulders Display (800wt uppercase) paired with Instrument Serif italic subtitle creates visual hierarchy that guides the eye: heading → subtitle → body → CTA. 3. NARRATIVE IDENTITY -- Brand manifesto creates "tribe" feeling. Self-Determination Theory: customers who identify with brand values have 3x higher lifetime value (Harvard Business Review). 4. BORDER FRAMING -- Top + bottom 1px border creates a "sacred space" effect, isolating the manifesto as important content.

HP51-MARQUEE
sections/fb04-marquee_streetwear.liquid CONVERSION PSYCHOLOGY (Frameblox Landing 04 Replica): 1. INFINITE SCROLL CAROUSEL -- Continuous horizontal movement triggers active search mode. 2. PAUSE-ON-HOVER -- Giving users control over motion satisfies autonomy need. 3. EDGE FADE GRADIENTS -- White to transparent masks on left/right edges create depth illusion. 4. SQUARE ASPECT RATIO (1:1) -- Maximizes visual impact in constrained horizontal space. 5. 3x ITEM DUPLICATION -- Items repeat 3 times for mathematically seamless infinite scroll.

HP51-NEW-DROPS
sections/fb04-new-drops_streetwear.liquid CONVERSION PSYCHOLOGY (Frameblox Landing 04 Replica): 1. PARADOX OF CHOICE -- 3 cards per row (desktop). Hick's Law: curated grid eliminates decision paralysis while still creating "collection feel." 2. GOLD BADGE ANCHORING -- "New" badge in warm gold (#ED9A1C) activates the Von Restorff Isolation Effect: visually distinct items are remembered 2.6x better than unmarked items (Baymard). 3. PRICE ANCHORING -- Crossed-out compare-at price next to current price anchors brain to higher value; perceives discount as savings. 4. HOVER MICRO-INTERACTION -- Card lifts + shadow deepens + "+" button turns blue. Fitts's Law: quick-add target is always visible. 5. ASPECT RATIO CONTROL -- 4:4.8 portrait aspect ratio matches fashion-forward product photography standards.

HP52-FAQ

+

How does Tuscan olive squalane benefit dry skin?+

Plant squalane derived from cold-pressed Tuscan olives matches the molecular structure of human sebum, absorbing instantly without pore-clogging heaviness.

Is the Sicilian clay drying on sensitive complexions?+

No, our terracotta clay is suspended in pure cold-pressed almond and olive lipid bases, ensuring that skin is gently detoxified while maintaining hydration.

Are international shipments fully insured and pre-cleared?+

Yes, all international deliveries are dispatched via DDP express courier with all local import taxes, customs, and duties 100% pre-paid.
